input.sha256_scope: The digest is of expected.json, whose /files map pins the SHA-256 and byte count of every one of the 23 corpus files individually: fidelity/*.pdf, fidelity/gate-test-font.ttf, and malformed/*.pdf. No third-party PDF, font, or image enters the repository.
input.provenance: Generated by tools/generate_pdf_fidelity_corpus.py and tools/generate_pdf_malformed_corpus.py. Every byte is authored by those scripts, including the embedded TrueType font, so the corpus carries this project's own licence rather than a third party's.

upstream.capture_method: Generated input, not a capture. The seven fidelity documents cover the four page kinds the entry gate names (a scanned page in both FlateDecode and DCTDecode form, a vector page, an embedded CID font, a form XObject) plus the two features the ADR names as silently droppable or substitutable (an axial shading, and text in a non-embedded standard font). The fifteen malformed documents are one named lie each, including a two-page document whose first page renders and whose second cannot, which is what makes the recorded per-page failure policy testable. Measurements taken against these files are recorded in docs/PDF_ENTRY_GATE_EVIDENCE.md.
upstream.environment: python 3.12, opencv-contrib-python 5.x for the DCTDecode encode only

expected.sha256_scope: Exact UTF-8 JSON file. Holds the per-file digests and the recorded fidelity measurement.

limitations: This port cannot render any of these files. The corpus exists to satisfy the PDF-001 entry gate, and the measurements in docs/PDF_ENTRY_GATE_EVIDENCE.md were taken by a disposable external harness against a candidate renderer that is deliberately not a dependency of this project. The committed test verifies only that the corpus itself has not drifted.

The fidelity numbers in expected.json are a record of one measurement on one machine against poppler as the reference renderer. They are not a tolerance any code enforces, and re-running them requires poppler and the candidate renderer, neither of which the offline gate has.

Synthetic documents, not real-world PDFs: no scanner noise, no incremental updates, no linearization, no real-world producer quirks. A real corpus would carry licensing this project cannot clear, which is why these are generated.
